'''Pokémon Adventures: The Articuno Ambush''' is the thirteenth monthly issue released by [[VIZ Media]] of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Mato]]. It contains chapters thirty and thirty-one of the {{MangaArc|Red, Green & Blue}}. The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of {{PAV|3}}. As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.
